package.name: rak_serial_link
package.description: Pure serial communication layer for the wheel chassis MCU. Speaks the 8-byte CAN v3 frame format from vehical_rak_chassis/docs/PROTOCOL.md over a UART (default /dev/wheel_motor, udev-resolved to ttyACM0; 921600 8N1). Independent of lidar/moveit/nav2/mecanum: this node owns the wire, only exposes raw TX/RX + safety_cmd service. Decision on what to send is the caller's problem.
